name: Damaged Goods
source:
It is 2021, a year after the devastating Coomer-19 pandemic. The whole world has suddenly changed because of it.Things are now different in many ways.

And that's where the story for three intelligent and cute girls begins. Coming from a small town they are going on a slice of life journey together.The beautiful Rose, Dean of the Elite Discipline Academy (EDA) is engaged to be married Mark soon. Her lovely friends Kelly and Jessica couldn't be more different. Just like fire and water! Along their way, there are dangers, desires, adventures and a lot of unexpected things around the corner.

Will they be able to fulfill all their dreams and wishes or will they burst like soap bubbles?
YOU will find it out!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sinappeal]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
2021年，距离毁灭性的Coomer-19疫情已经过去一年。它让整个世界骤然改变，如今的生活已在许多方面与过去大不相同。

三位聪慧可爱的女孩的故事，就从这里开始。来自小镇的她们，将一同踏上一段日常生活之旅。美丽的罗丝是精英训导学院（EDA）的院长，即将与未婚夫马克结婚。她的两位可爱好友凯莉与杰西卡，性格却截然不同，简直水火不容！一路上，危险、欲望、冒险与种种意料之外的事情，都在前方等着她们。

她们能否实现所有梦想与心愿，还是一切终将像肥皂泡般破灭？
答案，将由你来揭晓！
